display.purpose: Person name h1 on PersonDetail. Appears once per screen at most.

headline.purpose: Page section headings: Archive, Albums, People, Documents.

title.purpose: Settings section labels, modal headers. Heaviest weight in the system.

body.purpose: Description text, document content, metadata values in read mode. Cap at 65-75ch.

label.purpose: Section sub-labels, stat counts. Bold + tight tracking compensate for 10px size.

micro.purpose: Metadata field labels (Date taken, Caption, Rating). Always uppercase. Minimum color: --text-3.

shadows.name: modal
shadows.purpose: Settings modal overlay. The only shadow in the system.

shadows.name: overlay-deep
shadows.purpose: Album-picker overlay that appears over photos. Intentionally dark in both themes.

motion.name: fast
motion.purpose: Micro-interactions: row hover backgrounds, star hover color.

motion.name: standard
motion.purpose: Default for all state transitions: button hover, nav link color/border, ghost button color.

motion.name: deliberate
motion.purpose: Album cell gradient opacity on hover.

motion.name: thumbnail-zoom
motion.purpose: Photo and album thumbnail scale(1.05) on hover.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The primary action in any given context. Blue-tinted fill with Faded Steel text and border.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #dce5f5; color: #1d4db0; border: 1px solid #9bb8f5; border-radius: 3px; padding: 4px 12px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease-out, color 0.15s ease-out, border-color 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1d4db0; color: #f6f4ef; border-color: #1d4db0; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1d4db0; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Save Button
components.description: Appears only when confirming a save action. Sage green palette signals success without alarm.
components.css: .ds-btn-save { background: #d4edda; color: #1a5e35; border: 1px solid #7ecfa0; border-radius: 3px; padding: 4px 12px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-save:hover { background: #c3e4cc; } .ds-btn-save:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2a7848; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-save:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Navigation and utility actions where the label carries the meaning. Muted at rest, Faded Steel on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: none; border: none; color: #79786f; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 3px; transition: color 0.15s ease-out; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #1d4db0; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1d4db0; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 3px; }

components.name: Text Input with Label
components.description: Metadata field with micro-label above. Stroked border, white fill, 3px radius. Focus ring via :focus-visible.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; } .ds-field-label { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #79786f; } .ds-input { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #ccc9c2; border-radius: 3px; padding: 5px 10px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; color: #1c1b18; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1d4db0; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 3px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #9e9d94; }

components.name: Keyword Chip
components.description: Pill-shaped tag for photo keywords. Includes an accessible remove button with aria-label.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 3px; background: #dce5f5; border: 1px solid #9bb8f5; border-radius: 10px; padding: 1px 7px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; color: #1d4db0; } .ds-chip-remove { background: none; border: none; color: #79786f; cursor: pointer; padding: 0; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1; transition: color 0.1s ease-out; } .ds-chip-remove:hover { color: #1d4db0; } .ds-chip-remove:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1d4db0; outline-offset: 1px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Navigation Bar
components.description: 44px fixed top bar. Georgia wordmark left, system-ui nav links center, controls right. Active link: Faded Steel with bottom border.
components.html:
Family Files
PhotosAlbumsPeople
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; background: #f6f4ef; border-bottom: 1px solid #d5d2cb; padding: 0 24px; height: 44px; flex-shrink: 0; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-wordmark { font-family: "Georgia", "Times New Roman", serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: #1a3562; margin-right: 32px; white-space: nowrap; user-select: none; } .ds-nav-divider { width: 1px; height: 16px; background: #ccc9c2; margin-right: 32px; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-nav-link { display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 12px; height: 44px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; color: #79786f; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; box-sizing: border-box; transition: color 0.15s ease-out, border-color 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #1d4db0; border-bottom-color: #1d4db0; } .ds-nav-link--active { color: #1d4db0; border-bottom-color: #1d4db0; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1d4db0; outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Person Chip (Relative)
components.description: Clickable chip for a family member on PersonDetail. Shows name in Faded Steel and birth year in muted text.
components.css: .ds-person-chip { background: #e4e1da; border: 1px solid #ccc9c2; border-radius: 5px; padding: 6px 12px; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; transition: border-color 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-person-chip:hover { border-color: #1d4db0; } .ds-person-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1d4db0; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-person-chip__name { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: #1d4db0; } .ds-person-chip__sub { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; color: #9e9d94; }

components.name: Section Label
components.description: Section divider used throughout PersonDetail. 10px uppercase label with a bottom border separator.
components.css: .ds-section-label { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #79786f; padding-bottom: 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid #ccc9c2; margin-bottom: 12px; }

narrative.overview:
Family Files is a private archive, not a product. The interface recedes so that photographs, faces, and documents take the foreground. Every design decision that asks 'should this be more prominent?' is answered by asking whether the prominence serves a person, a photo, or a story, not the application itself.

The aesthetic is warm ash and faded steel: parchment-toned surfaces that feel like paper rather than screen, a steel-blue accent as rare and deliberate as a library stamp, and a serif typeface that appears only where history warrants it. There are two typographic voices. Georgia carries the archival register; system-ui carries everything functional and disappears on use.

Depth is expressed through tonal surface stepping, not shadow. Six named surface values step from surface to surface-active; the eye reads the elevation without needing a drop shadow to announce it. Shadows are reserved for one context only: the modal that floats above the application.
keyCharacteristics: Content-first: nothing in the chrome competes with the photograph
Two-voice typography: Georgia for the archival register, system-ui for the functional register
Faded steel accent on 10% or less of any screen; rarity is the signal
Warm ash neutrals across six tonal steps; no surface is pure white or pure black
Tactile and honest controls: visible borders, clear affordances, legible at larger text sizes
Tonal elevation; shadows appear only for modal overlays

rules.name: The Rarity Rule
rules.body: The accent (Faded Steel) is used on 10% or less of any given screen: one active nav link, primary interactive affordances, focus rings. Its presence is a signal, not decoration.

rules.name: The No-Pure-Extremes Rule
rules.body: No #000 or #fff. Every surface is tinted toward the warm-ash hue at minimum chroma. Pure black and pure white have no place in an archive made by human hands.

rules.name: The Contrast Contract
rules.body: --text-4 fails WCAG AA at 9-10px. Use --text-3 as the minimum for any information-bearing micro-label. Placeholder text and decorative separators may use --text-4; field labels may not.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Georgia is the archival voice; it appears only when the subject has historical weight. system-ui is the functional voice; it appears everywhere else and disappears on use. Never mix within a single component.

rules.name: The Small-Type Contract
rules.body: Any text at 10px or below must be uppercase with at least +0.08em letter-spacing. Use --text-3 or above. Dimmer colors may carry decorative separators, not labels.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces at rest cast no shadow. Layering is expressed tonally. A new shadow is a new exception; add it deliberately.

dos: Use Georgia only for person names, page h1 headings, album names in photo cards, and the wordmark.
Use the accent on 10% or less of any screen. Its appearance must feel like a signal.
Use --text-3 or above for any information-bearing label at 10px or below.
Add aria-label to every button whose accessible name is a glyph (←, ⚙, ☀, ×).
Make every interactive element keyboard-reachable: tabIndex, role, and onKeyDown.
Let the photograph dominate the Photos view. Minimize surrounding chrome.
Use tonal surface stepping for perceived depth.
Add role=dialog, aria-modal, aria-labelledby, and a focus trap to any modal overlay.
donts: Don't produce a generic admin dashboard: colorless surfaces, data-grid density, no warmth.
Don't use consumer photo app patterns (Google Photos, iCloud): algorithm-sorted equal grids, platform branding.
Don't use genealogy SaaS patterns (Ancestry, MyHeritage): dated dense forms, commercial-first hierarchy.
Don't use a border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe.
Don't use background-clip: text with a gradient for decorative text color.
Don't mix Georgia and system-ui within a single component.
Don't override outline: none on focusable elements.
Don't use --text-4 for metadata field labels or information-carrying micro-labels.
Don't animate layout properties (width, height, padding, top, left).
